_comment: Seed fixture for the reporter-info-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000004065 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — fourth port after
activity-log-htmx (MR !2334 / ka-0000004584), related-tickets-htmx
(MR !2346 / ka-0000005540), and header-incident-summary-htmx
(MR !2347 / ka-0000005304)). Strategy A — port-then-soak: lives
alongside the Go-coded `reporter-info` slug rather than replacing it.
Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: reporter-info-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/reporter-info-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `reporter-info` renderer at
widgets_phase4.go::renderReporterInfo — flat name/email/org/role.
The htmx template intentionally does NOT construct the Copy-email
action button (it needs the Go-side CopyToClipboardAction helper);
button rendering is a parity gap documented in the port doc and in
TestReporterInfoParity.

fields.template_source:
{{- $name := index .Payload "name" -}} {{- $email := index .Payload "email" -}} {{- $org := index .Payload "org" -}} {{- $role := index .Payload "role" -}}
{{if $name}}
Name
{{$name}}
{{end}} {{if $email}}
Email
{{$email}}
{{end}} {{if $org}}
Org
{{$org}}
{{end}} {{if $role}}
Role
{{$role}}
{{end}}
